title: A Dinosaur Ate Our Rent: The Complete First Week

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: Welcome to our first week with a dinosaur. The rent money did not survive.

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: Next, Max tried to get a job. We needed the income.

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: With the job situation unclear, Zig tried collecting rent.

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: A performance review followed. Results were mixed.

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: Then Max discovered accounting. We are still recovering.

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: By day six, everyone needed some quiet.

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: Finally, we added up the damage. And the benefits.

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: That was our first week. Tell us: keep the dinosaur, or find him a new home? Your decision can shape the next chapter.
